src: monochromatic 4-connected foreground objects, classified by whether their bbox encloses a background hole
path: closed objects slide straight upward in their original columns; no-hole objects slide straight downward in their original columns, stopping at the edge or the nearest settled object
trajectory: move each whole object without changing its shape or color
transform: redraw the settled objects on an empty background canvas, erasing their original positions
multi_step: settle upward movers from top to bottom and downward movers from bottom to top so same-column overlaps stack without crossing
